vlog_arc.theme: Protecting the first hour: how discipline, not willpower, wins the morning

beats.mon: Leo stands in his kitchen before sunrise and says the week's plan already feels fragile by 9am most days, so this week he's tracking what actually holds it together.
beats.tue: Leo walks through his literal morning stack on camera — not a lecture, just what he does in order and why each step exists.
beats.wed: Leo sits down, unscripted, and reads a real customer line out loud, then goes quiet for a second before explaining why it hit him.
beats.thu: Leo shares one number from the business this week, plain and unpolished, framed as learning in public rather than a milestone.
beats.fri: Leo talks about a moment training this week where discipline mattered more than motivation, and ties it back to why he built the brand.
beats.sat: Leo is with his family, half off-duty, reflecting briefly on why Saturdays are the proof the system is working, not a break from it.
beats.sun: Leo sits in stillness before the week resets, speaks briefly about faith and purpose grounding the discipline, then previews what's next.
